title: A3 — Data ingestion and transformation
bodyMarkdown:
## Data ingestion and transformation

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab.
